Summarize Transcript-Level Matrices to Gene Level

Source: R/IsoformicExperiment-class.R
summarize_to_gene.Rd

Sums the values of all isoforms of a gene. A length assay is combined as the abundance-weighted mean when an abundance assay is supplied in the same list (the tximport convention). This is the function used by gene_assays() and can be called directly on matrices.

Usage

summarize_to_gene(x, tx_to_gene)

Arguments

x

A numeric matrix (transcripts in rows) or a named list of such matrices sharing row names.

tx_to_gene

Data frame with transcript_id and gene_id columns.

Value

A matrix, or a named list of matrices, with genes in rows.

Examples

iso <- example_isoformic()
g <- summarize_to_gene(assay(iso, "abundance"), tx_to_gene(iso))
